sources.title: Efficient Attention Mechanisms for Large Language Models:
sources.snippet: Transformer-based architectures have become the prevailing backbone of large language models. However, the quadratic time and memory complexity of self-attention remains a fundamental obstacle to efficient long-context modeling. To address this limitation, recent research has introduced two principal categories of efficient attention mechanisms.

sources.title: Efficient Attention Methods
sources.snippet: For each category, we also develop a unified analysis framework and offer perspectives on open challenges and promising directions for future research on efficient attention. To the best of our knowledge, this survey is the most comprehensive survey on efficient attention.
